name: build-targets
title: Build targets: choose Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, macOS or web in the editor and build, with private console targets later (thirteen stages)
issue: User request, 2026-11-10: 'I would like for the engine to be able to allow the user to select a build target in the engine editor UI like windows, linux, android, ios, web, and maybe other console toolchains in the future like switch'. Design and stage table: orchestrator/proposals/build-targets-design.md. Split into one item per stage (bt1..bt13) before launching. User decisions 2026-11-10 (section 6 of the design): D1 local builds (Apple targets in GitHub Actions), D2 native mobile rendering as a later goal (software first), D5 macOS with iOS, D6 zip with 7z as an option, D7 no Mac (GitHub Actions macOS runners). Later the same day: D3 the final game is always a full build from source (prebuilt players only as an extra, later option); D4 a new desktop player, lua_project stays a demo; D8 Jolt and Box2D only on mobile.
acceptance: The editor lists the targets, shows what each one needs, builds any target the machine can build, and runs it on a device for device targets
One command line (n2build) does the same for CI and people
A console target can be added from outside the repository
Existing targets keep their behaviour, tests, smoke runs and size budgets at every stage
The editor can pick and build the targets that already work (Windows, Linux, web) after stage 3, before any platform-layer change
gate: approved by the user on 2026-11-10 (all stages); split per stage; every stage decisions D1-D8 made on 2026-11-10
notes: Reviewer: no behaviour change on existing targets, platform code only behind the platform layer, no signing secret in the project, host, logs or protocol.
